title: You're not fully booked. You're fully rented.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B — scene/organic. Slides 1,3,4,5 are pure AI photos. Slides 2 & 6 are DEVICE-COMPOSITE: generate a photo where an iPhone 17 (s2) or a laptop (s6) has a BLANK PURE-WHITE screen, then Claude composites the saved booking-app UI onto that screen (screen.app tells which). When Kim sends each device photo, Claude reads the 4 screen-corner coordinates and sets `screen.quad` to composite it in perspective. Drop photos into assets/scene-01/ as s1,s2,s3,s4,s5,s6 .png.

slides.headline:

slides.sub: A boutique-hotel owner's quiet, expensive truth.
slides.imagePrompt: A boutique-hotel owner (40s, warm, three-quarter so not a clear identifiable portrait) standing behind a beautiful minimalist modern reception desk at blue hour, lit by a warm modern lamp and a small green neon glow. Rich modern Scandinavian-boho lobby: walnut wood, cream plaster walls, a large leafy monstera. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD a calm darker wall / negative space for the headline; subject lower-right. slides.imageId: SCENE-01 / 2  (PHOTO + COMPOSITE — iPhone 17, blank white screen)
slides.title: Every booking feels like a ((win)).
slides.body: Until you count how little of it you actually keep.
slides.imagePrompt: Camera pulled BACK (not a tight close-up). Two hands holding an iPhone 17 (Dynamic Island, thin bezels) UP in the TOP portion of the frame at a warm walnut cafe table, morning light, a flat-white and a small plant softly out of focus to the sides. DEVICE-COMPOSITE SLIDE — read carefully. The phone must be PERFECTLY STRAIGHT AND FRONT-ON: screen plane exactly parallel to the camera, ZERO rotation, ZERO tilt, no perspective, edges square to the frame. Its screen must be a COMPLETELY BLANK PURE-WHITE rectangle (#FFFFFF) — no UI, no icons, no text, no reflections, no glare, nothing overlapping it, all four corners fully visible with a little clearance. The device sits in the UPPER ~55% of the frame; the LOWER ~40% is a clean, empty, softly-shadowed darker surface for text. Deliver ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS PHOTOGRAPH natively in 4:5 (1080x1350). Do NOT letterbox, pad, extend or outpaint — no horizontal seam anywhere; the empty lower area must be part of the photographed scene (a real table top, floor or wall in shadow). [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: ==25%== of that win was never yours.
slides.body: The middleman took his cut before the money ever reached you.
slides.imagePrompt: Modern editorial still-life, slight overhead angle: a guest's hand tapping a sleek matte-black contactless card on a minimalist modern payment terminal at a cream-and-walnut hotel reception, warm directional light, a small potted plant softly out of focus behind. Contemporary and premium. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD a calm darker surface for text; hand + terminal lower-right. NO cash, no coins, no old objects. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: The guest searched your name.
slides.body: The platform just ~~introduced~~ charged you for a guest you already had.
slides.imagePrompt: A stylish traveller with a modern weekend duffel walking into a warm modern boutique-hotel lobby, seen from behind / three-quarter (face not identifiable), glancing at an iPhone 17 held naturally (screen not readable, ambient glow only). Golden interior light, lush plants, walnut and cream, a soft green neon accent by the desk. LEAVE THE BOTTOM THIRD calm and darker for text; subject centred, upper-mid. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.body: More OTA bookings just means a bigger cut skimmed off the top.

Calm 'sold-out luxury' storytelling. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD calm negative space (plain warm wall / ceiling) for text; bed and window lower. NO keys, no numbers, no signage. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
